items.title: Extend batch request context, VM configuration, and error result models
items.summary: The coarse models.tsp group contains several related but distinct additions: optional context-bearing resource alternatives, notification and VM allocation information, paged error/acknowledgement contracts, flexible minimum capacity, post-start agent verification, and GetInstanceView operation classification. It also versions relaxed resources inputs and loosely typed VM configuration passthrough. Preview decorators control applicability; file membership alone does not establish one feature.

inferenceResults.rationale: The delete request retains the existing resources input and makes it optional only from the preview using @madeOptional. The new optional resourcesWithContext alternative preserves the existing resources-only form. The deterministic SDK candidate already covers optionality; this source hunk establishes no additional breaking contract.

The start request's Resources member retains its type and identity; @madeOptional preserves earlier requiredness and relaxes preview input. Adding a separately versioned optional context-bearing alternative does not invalidate existing resource-only requests, and the supplied SDK candidate covers the represented member change.

The deallocate request uses @madeOptional for preview-only input relaxation and @added for the optional resourcesWithContext alternative. Existing resources-only input remains valid, and the deterministic optionality candidate covers the represented SDK change without an additional incompatibility.

The hibernate request retains resources and relaxes its requiredness in the preview while adding an optional context-bearing alternative. The previous resources-only request satisfies the stated exactly-one choice; its SDK optionality change already has a deterministic candidate.

The reimage request retains its Resources identity while making it optional and adding an optional preview context-bearing alternative. The supplied bulkReimage method is newly available relative to the selected stable artifact baseline; no preexisting stable method contract is shown to be invalidated.

inferenceResults.rationale: The Python-scoped @clientName edits can change generated enum member identities, so they cannot be treated as nonbreaking decorator noise. The frozen neutral evidence provides neither baseline Python NetworkApiVersion member names nor its availability in the selected stable public SDK; an existing-member rename cannot be established or excluded.

Neutral facts still report string/type and do not establish actual baseline C# names, generated member equivalence, or UUID consumption. Language-specific before/after evidence is required; the wrapper-equivalence exception is not assumed.

applicableGuidance.excerpt: Always make the last enum value the preview and apply `@previewVersion` to it. Only one version may be marked with the `@previewVersion` decorator.

applicableGuidance.guidanceSection: Making Changes to your TypeSpec spec
